description: The Gallery's launch content goes from candidate photos to a finished curated set. With the Team Lead: confirm which of the 10 supplied photos ship and their order. Content-steward writes alt text for every photo and captions where they add context, in the site's tone. The photo manifest carries the final set; the grid and (when present) lightbox render the words. No unconfirmed facts in captions.
title: Launch content pass: curated photo set, order, alt text, and captions
acceptance_criteria: The Team Lead has confirmed the shipped photo selection and order
Every shipped photo has meaningful alt text; captions appear only where they add context
The full confirmed set renders in the live grid with correct order and sections
content-fidelity gate passes on the shipped words
